features.name: Spell Dance
features.description:
At 2nd level, a spell dancer gains the ability to expend 1 point from his arcane pool as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) to gain a +10 enhancement bonus to his movement rate and a +2 dodge bonus to Armor Class against attacks of opportunity provoked by moving through threatened spaces for 1 minute. For every four levels beyond 2nd, the spell dancer gains another +10 enhancement bonus to movement and +2 to AC against attacks of opportunity provoked from movement. At 6th level, once per spell dance as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift), the spell dancer may use one of the following on himself as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift): [*blur*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/b/blur), [*fly*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/f/fly), or [*haste*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/h/haste). These abilities last for 1 round. At 10th level, the spell dancer may instead take a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) to use [*hop*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/h/hop) as a spell-like ability once during a spelldance. At 14th level, the spell dancer may instead choose to take a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) to gain [*freedom of movement*](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/magic/spells/f/freedom-of-movement/) for 1d4 rounds.

This ability replaces the red mage’s ability to expend points from his arcane pool as a [swift action](https://www.finalfantasyd20.com/system-rules/pathfinder-basics/#swift) to grant any weapon he is holding magic bonuses for 1 minute.

features.name: Arcane Movement
features.description:
At 5th level, whenever a spell dancer casts a red mage spell, he gains a competence bonus on Acrobatics, Climb, Escape Artist, and Stealth checks equal to the spell’s level until the beginning of his next turn.

This ability replaces red magery gained at 5th level.

features.name: Dance of Avoidance
features.description:
At 7th level, while wearing light or no armor, a spell dancer gains a +2 insight bonus to Armor Class.

This ability replaces armored mage (medium).
Manual sheet handling: record any stated choice, companion, weapon, spell, feat, temporary modifier or condition on the existing sheet entries; this card does not apply global combat effects.

features.name: Greater Dance of Avoidance
features.description:
At 10th level, while wearing light or no armor, a spell dancer’s insight bonus to Armor Class increases to +4.

This ability replaces armored mage (shield).

features.name: Ruby Arcana
features.description:
The following ruby arcana complement the spell dancer archetype: arcane cloak, prescient defense, close range, concentrate, hasted assault, spell shield.
